title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the edge — detail and forms without losing the page.
usage: For detail views and edit forms that belong to the current page. On narrow screens it takes most of the width.
a11y: Uses native <dialog>. Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the panel. Escape, backdrop clicks and labelled close buttons dismiss it and return focus to the opener. All instances initialize independently; existing IDs are preserved and missing IDs are generated. Closing is immediate, as in the original implementation; the closed dialog is inert. Native modal focus does not use focusout dismissal.
